issues.area: correctness (S3-R16 1(a), S3-R26 item 1 and item 12 answer 6.3, S3-R17 item 4)
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineFollow.swift:800-809 (followLayers' pin check through waitingTarget(_:epoch:) at :1572-1585, which returns nil for a job queued again at the pinned epoch). Both callers are affected: rerouteListing (:774, owed re-route batches) and joinListing (waiting joins' chains). The doc that records the behaviour is :765-773.
issues.problem: An owed re-route, or a waiting join, whose layer pinned its ids to a job at an attempt's end follows the engine's copy at the replay once that job's drained publication got ENOENT and was re-queued at the same epoch. Visit-first joined the ids to the job while it published; they rode its re-queued attempt, and that attempt's outcome answered them. 58b278e fixed this same class for the InboundMove caller only; the draft lists the pin caller as an UNCONFIRMED sibling. My probe PROBE-C21C-PIN-ENOENT-404 uses rr21-T8b's shape, with X's fresh attempt failing .permanentMissing(404). It ran 2/2 deterministic per case, release, with no invariant violations. In followVisitedFirst without owing, W1…W3 get failed(notFound) and X holds zz-a1…a3 after the replay; with owing (followIDsPerTurn 4, owed [3], pinned, re-queued at the pin's epoch), they get ok(20 B), W's job holds zz-a1…a3, and W's content is requested where visit-first never requests it. Owing alone changes the answer. In sweepFollowsFirst, both paths give ok(20 B): without owing, O's commit left three waiting joins with chains ("zz-a1->X chain true"…), and joinListing follows the same pin. The ENOENT lands before both answers, and no apply comes between the end and the replay. Ruling 6.3's premise, that this equals the reference, therefore fails for a terminal failure of the fresh attempt. Nothing here comes from a live origin gate.
issues.fix:
1. Commit the probe's shape as a failing test in EngineFollowBarrierRerouteRequeueTests.swift. Run it in both orders, owing and not, and assert visit-first's answers: W1…W3 .failure(.notFound), V2 .failure(.notFound), and no request for W's content.
2. In followLayers, keep the pin for a job queued again at the pinned epoch with its end still recorded and no apply followed since that end. This is the condition rerouteOnVisit's queued arm uses: job.state == .queued && job.attemptEnd?.failedAfter == appliesFollowed. Return layer.outgoing, as for a job still at its end, so the replay joins the re-queued attempt.
3. With an apply followed since the end, continue the walk from that apply's layer, as the commit pin does. To do that, record the copy serial at the ENOENT re-queue in publicationFailed, like reroutePinCommits.
4. rr21-T8b's state assertion at EngineFollowBarrierRerouteRequeueTests.swift:124 then changes one to one, with a G3 entry: after the replay, X holds zz-a1…a3 and zz-x, and W's job appears at X's commit. Its answers are unchanged.
5. Correct the doc at :765-773 and the draft's record of answer 6.3.
The probe is saved at .build-orchestrator/s3f-probes-c21/VerifyC21CorrectPinENOENTProbes.swift, with its log.

issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineCommands.swift:992-1039 (withdrawPurged, run in performPurge's first turn at :968-971, before its first await) and :1056 (withdrawPurgedJoins).
issues.problem:
A purge withdraws the non-user interests of every job in one actor turn. It sorts all of jobs.keys, filters each job's assets with isPurged, sorts each job's interests and each job's withdrawn ids, then calls dropGroupMember and removeInterest per id. My release probes, each best of 3 at a 1-minute load of 10 or less:
- **PROBE-C21C-PURGE-QUEUED.** 10,000-member prefetch group, one job per member, 3 running and the rest queued, then purge(.all). Longest engine-actor wait 54.47 / 56.29 / 54.78 ms at {7.65 61.44 144.07}, and again 57.43 / 55.96 / 58.37 at {4.85 38.44 120.84}. With one shared job of 10,000 ids: 12.20 / 12.34 / 12.25 ms, and 12.03 / 12.46 / 13.62.
- **PROBE-C21C-PURGE-PARTS.** Times withdrawPurged(.all) alone inside the actor: 54.83 / 53.86 / 67.57 ms, and 13.11 / 13.16 / 12.36 ms for the shared job. dropBindings and settleRun took 0.00 ms. Load {5.01 39.04 121.54}.
- **PROBE-C21C-PURGE-JOINS.** The c20 DEFER-BEHIND shape, with 10,000 members' joins waiting. 13.08 / 13.16 / 13.04 ms with 9,216 joins in the verdict's bucket, and 11.84 / 11.52 / 12.55 ms with 9,489 joins in the queue. Load {7.36 60.48 143.25} to {6.88 56.94 140.05}.
No BenchSync case covers this. The only purge case is purgeWhileOwedTurns, which sits at the edge: 9.57 ms best in my full run at {5.80 11.22 14.11} and 9.59 ms alone at {3.78 6.65 11.86}, against the fixer's 10.04 ms miss. The job walk predates s3-base (61b6eb9a, 16d55851); S3-R5 binds every turn at 10,000 records.
issues.fix:
1. Bound the purge's withdrawal per turn (S3-R5). For example, withdraw jobs and waiting joins in owned follow-up turns of at most followIDsPerTurn ids, and re-validate each job by its epoch after every await, with a REENTRANCY comment.
2. Make the store's purge wait for the last slice, or keep the slices' joins withdrawn meanwhile.
3. For .all, skip the per-job isPurged filter and the per-interest sorts, since every id is purged.
4. Pin the fix twice (S3-R23 item 3): a BenchSync case at 10,000 (one job per member, one job of 10,000 ids, and joins in a bucket and in the queue) at best of 3 within c2Budget, and a deterministic test that a single turn stops at the bound, whose drop-mutant fails it.
The probes are saved at .build-orchestrator/s3f-probes-c21/VerifyC21CorrectPurgeProbes.swift and VerifyC21CorrectReqsC20Shapes.swift.
